messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: High latency SLO burn detected in us-east-1 for /v1/generate. p95 and p99 increased above configured thresholds. PD incident: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
jamie: acked. I'm oncall, taking lead. brief?
ravi: seeing p95 ~450ms -> 700ms, p99 ~2.3s -> 4.8s on the store of inference pods in us-east-1. error rate is normal. looks like tail latency, not errors. :eyes:
maria: 👀 any recent deploys to inference-runtime?
ravi: deploy 12:02 UTC rolled out ~12:10, small kernel change for KV-cache eviction. metrics jump aligns with that window.
jamie: ok, start triage checklist. can someone post the query and top graphs?
ravi: query pasted:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le))
```
jamie: thanks. probable KV cache thrash after deploy. first quick mitigation: scale up inference pool and enable fallback model routing for high-latency routes. 
lee: scaling now — running: `kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=12`
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by jamie at 2765432105
maria: adding temporary route weight: set fallback_model=gpt-medium-quant for 25% of traffic from the api-gateway to reduce hot-spotting on large model pods. applying via patch now.
ravi: KV-cache hit ratio dropped from 96% -> 62% at 12:18. that explains cost of recompute. purging caches might help or warming, but purge will spike more recompute. instead I'll pin prefix caching for top 50 keys.
jamie: good call. pls do incremental changes and monitor. if p99 not improving in next 3min escalate to platform lead.
(2m pass)
ravi: scaled replicas up, route weight applied. p95 now ~310ms, p99 ~1.1s. still above SLO but improving. :+1:
jamie: thanks. flip autoscaler min to 8 while we stabilize to avoid rapid downscale: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/autoscaler -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","min":8}'`
lee: autoscaler min bumped.
maria: also rolled back the kernel eviction patch to previous stable commit on one canary node to test — traffic routed 10% to canary.
ravi: canary looks healthy, p99 ~220ms on that subset. suggests change in eviction logic is culprit.
jamie: ok plan: (1) keep scaled replicas and autoscaler min, (2) continue fallback routing 25%, (3) roll back deploy globally in 30m if canary confirms.
pagerduty-bot: INC12345: Escalation policy will notify platform-lead in 10 minutes if not resolved.
jamie: Customer impact: hosted API customers in us-east-1 may see slower tail latency for large-context generations. no errors/loss of tokens. we'll prepare a short status update if p99 stays >1s for another 15m.
lee: noted, I'll stand by for handoff. I'm taking first-follow for next 15m then handing to night oncall (lee -> night:lee).
jamie: handoff plan: jamie will stay until stable or 12:50, then hand to lee. create incident ticket and assign to platform infra for root cause. action items: `RC-INC12345` created.
ravi: devs confirm rollback candidate ready. I'll coordinate deploy if we need it.
maria: after rollback and 20m observation we'll run perf regression tests and postmortem.
jamie: update: p99 currently 0.95s, p95 260ms. trending down. leaving a note to escalate if p99 >=1.2s again.
lee: ack, will take 12:50 handoff if still open.
jamie: once we close, we need a blameless postmortem with timeline + mitigation to avoid KV-cache thrash on future evictions. tagging infra and release engineering. :memo:
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: monitoring (last update 2765432205)
jamie: closing temp thread note: will post final incident summary in #incidents channel after postmortem. thanks all. :tada:
